feed.title: NPR Programs: All Things Considered
feed.subtitle: All Things Considered hosts Ailsa Chang, Mary Louise Kelly, Juana Summers and Scott Detrow present the program's trademark mix of news, interviews, commentaries, reviews, and offbeat features 7 days a week.

entry.title: The role of a pilot during a ground stop, according to an expert
entry.summary: As the nationwide aviation ground stop continues, there are still planes in the sky. Pilots are having to navigate this situation as we continue to learn more.

entry.title: What passengers at D.C.'s Reagan National Airport say about the FAA ground stop
entry.summary: All flights across the United States are grounded and millions of passengers are stranded. NPR talked to passengers at Ronald Reagan Washington National Airport.

entry.title: DHS head Markwayne Mullin says there is not a threat to the U.S. amid FAA ground stop
entry.summary: Department of Homeland Security Secretary Markwayne Mullin spoke to at the White House on Friday afternoon after the FAA issues a total ground stop. NPR was there for the briefing.

entry.title: Stuck on the tarmac without information: Travelers share their ground stop experiences
entry.summary: Passengers stuck on airplanes on tarmacs across the country during the FAA ground stop on Friday share their stories.

entry.title: What we know about the FAA nationwide ground stop
entry.summary: The Federal Aviation Administration took an extraordinary step Friday afternoon by issuing a nationwide ground stop. No planes are taking off at any airport and millions of passengers are stranded.

entry.title: Here's what the FAA's ground stop looks like at Washington Dulles International Airport
entry.summary: The FAA has issued a nationwide ground stop. NPR's Sacha Pfeiffer talks with Tom Lintner, the former head of air traffic investigations with FAA and air traffic controller, who has a view of Dulles.

entry.title: Is there an opening for Nvidia's competitors, now that Jensen Huang is out?
entry.summary: NPR's Scott Detrow talks with Dylan Patel of the AI and semiconductor research firm SemiAnalysis about Jensen Huang's departure from Nvidia, and whether it opens up the field for Nvidia's competitors.

entry.title: With his challenge to Schumer, Van Hollen forces a debate over Democrats' mandate
entry.summary: Democrats say they have a mandate to deliver change, but as the party gets ready to retake the majority in both the House and Senate, there are divides over who should lead it.

entry.title: Why people are Robert Caro's 'The Power Broker' out loud over several days
entry.summary: A marathon reading of The Power Broker by Robert Caro is ongoing in Brooklyn, featuring alternating reader in 10-minute timeslots, around the clock over the course of several days.

entry.title: Microsoft outage disrupts work and gives some a chance to unplug
entry.summary: Millions of individuals, organizations and businesses were left without access to Microsoft's Outlook email on Thursday. Some people celebrated a day without email, while others work around obstacles.
